medium: Pencil on a spiral-bound sketchbook page
provenance: Drawn by Larry from memory on 2026-09-05, the day of the photograph-by-photograph sitting. His son photographed the page in the sketchbook the same afternoon (phone photograph, file timestamp 13:31) and sent it to the archive; the sheet stays with the family. He offered to draw the three sheets himself; his son had not raised it. They were looking at photographs together, and after he had explained more than once where one thing stood in relation to another he said it would be easier to draw it. He was not looking at any photograph while drawing. The three sheets were drawn in one sitting in the order photographed, and he wrote each label as he drew the thing it names. He talked as he drew all three; his son listened and did not take notes, so what he said survives only as his son's later summaries, filed as paraphrase recollections and shown below.
title: “Nui Ba Den”
description: A plan drawn in pencil on a sketchbook page, photographed with the spiral binding at the top. The words NUI BA DEN sit near the centre. Near the top edge is a box labelled FORT, with two smaller boxes drawn against the binding above it. To the left, the word GENERATORS is written above a rectangle enclosing a row of small arches. A long curved line sweeps from the top-left of the page down the left side, around the bottom, and up the right, enclosing most of the drawing; short lines at the upper left branch from it. In the lower centre a rounded shape is labelled HELI PAD, with several straight lines fanning downward from it toward the bottom edge. Right of centre is a small unlabelled box, and in the bottom-left corner a scribbled mark. Nothing on the sheet indicates scale, compass direction, or the slope.
researchNotes: Two of the four labels are things he has already put on the mountain in words: the French fort at his radio position (VN-0009, 'the stone is the french fort, my radio was outside') and the helicopter pad where the trees were being felled (VN-0157). Generators had not been mentioned before this sheet; they are new testimony. The unlabelled box and the mark in the bottom-left corner are not interpreted here. His son reports two things said at this sheet (paraphrase recollections of 2026-09-05): at the generators, that he would change them or add gas to them when he was up there; at the fort, that Captain Kennedy slept there and sometimes he did too.
